$comment: The single machine-readable source for R1-R8 and A1-A7 status. Every prose summary count MUST be derived from this file, never hand-counted: the 2026-08-12 status report stated 'four of eight requirements and five of seven criteria verified' while its own table showed neither number. Statuses: VERIFIED | PARTIAL | IMPLEMENTED_NOT_PROVEN | NOT_STARTED | BLOCKED | NEEDS_PREZ.
evaluated_at_head: the architecture-closure commit that introduces this file, child of merge 4594ce995666d41849fe2466661e2a2eac1c10b8 (git names the SHA; a file cannot know its own commit)
final_note: Every VERIFIED below is verified ON THE STATED HEAD. Final acceptance requires re-running the concurrency matrix and regression on the closing P0B-19 head; rows carry final_reverification_pending accordingly.

R1.title: Concurrency-safe identifiers; read-then-write over an unlocked append prohibited

R2.title: Exactly one terminal EvalRow per started run
R2.needs_prez: A-02 redefines the guarantee as system-including-recovery; ratification pending
evidence: NO red sample of Race B exists; NO SIGKILL trial has run (P0B-18)

R3.title: Idempotent writes; duplicate detection independent of an invalidatable read
evidence: test/ledger.test.ts: exact route retry no-op; conflicting route retry typed error; exact/conflicting reserved-ADR retry; ship-level terminal-eval conflict
gate-label case rides the shared #appendUnique path; its direct test lands in P0B-16

R4.title: Crash-safe finalization; partial state attributable to a run_id

R5.title: Atomic or recoverable ledger mutation; torn lines detectable by validate
evidence: torn line throws at src/files.ts:175 and aborts validation; per-file reporting and a dedicated test land in P0B-15/16

R6.title: Deterministic contention tests
evidence: allocation + append barriers exercised: test/barrier.test.ts, test/ledger.test.ts
finalization barriers (before-intent, before-terminal-eval, before-marker, adr:before-create) are placed but have no contention tests yet (P0B-16/18)

R7.title: validate exits 0 after N concurrent runs, N in {2,3,10}, zero duplicate ids, ADRs unique and unmodified

R8.title: Abandoned-worker recovery; ownership distinguishes in-progress from abandoned
evidence: ownership state + liveness + quarantine-at-lock-level VERIFIED: test/lock.test.ts

A1.title: N concurrent runs -> exactly N terminal EvalRows

A4.title: Every ADR unique; no accepted ADR modified

A6.title: The contention test fails on the pre-fix code

A7.title: Existing behavior unchanged
evidence: 91/91 tests incl. 20 merged containment; validate 0; demo costUsd 0.068 byte-compared; threat matrix 17/17

derived_counts.$comment: Derive with: node -e "const s=require('./requirements-status.json'); const c=o=>Object.values(o).reduce((a,r)=>(a[r.status]=(a[r.status]||0)+1,a),{}); console.log(c(s.requirements), c(s.acceptance))"
